mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record_in ( SUPPLIER_ID,PRODUCT_ID,RECORD_IN_NUMBER, RECORD_IN_TIME,USER_ID,REPO_ID, REMARKS,CREATE_TIME,IS_DELETE ) VALUES ( #{supplierId},#{productId},#{recordInNumber}, #{recordInTime},#{userId},#{repoId}, #{remarks},#{createTime},#{isDelete} )
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(bb.count,0) AS "count",aa.date AS "time" FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(@cdate := DATE_ADD(@cdate,INTERVAL -1 MONTH),'%Y-%m') AS DATE FROM (SELECT @cdate := DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) FROM record_in) a LIMIT 12) aa LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(record_in_number) AS COUNT,DATE_FORMAT(record_in_time,'%Y-%m') AS mon FROM record_in GROUP BY mon) bb ON aa.date=bb.mon ORDER BY aa.date ASC
SELECT product_id,sum(record_in_number) AS 'count' FROM record_in WHERE record_in_time >= #{startTime} AND record_in_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY product_id
SELECT SUM(RECORD_IN_NUMBER) FROM record_in WHERE DATE(RECORD_IN_TIME) = CURDATE()
